blockers.description: Slice projection is blocked by seeded provider blockers.

limitations: Coverage is metadata-only and bounded to five public Gaussian 16 Rev. C.01 WordPress page records plus the public Rev. C.02 release-note record and platform PDF.
Private manuals, examples, binaries, basis payloads, checkpoints, user data, calculation artifacts, execution authorization, convergence, and scientific acceptance remain outside this pack.
Technical official-document coverage metadata is partial unless all dimensions are complete.
The C.01 keyword, IOp, utility, option, and user-reference leaf graph is not completely enumerated or receipt-bound.
The C.02 materials are a release delta and cannot establish a complete version-matched C.02 reference.
Slice references are exact and derived from the provider manifest.
